scope: Local filesystem repositories; synthetic payloads; no rest-server, Kubernetes or provider deployment

source.binding: No repository source revision or runner fingerprint recorded; this proof qualifies the identified upstream Restic binary.

restic.version: restic 0.19.1 compiled with go1.26.4 on darwin/amd64

scenarios.name: Independent secondary recovery and retention
scenarios.details: Separate passwords and matching chunker parameters; 2 MiB payload restored without cache with primary repository, password and capture unavailable. Primary forget/prune and another copy preserved the secondary point.

scenarios.name: Interrupted copy and retry
scenarios.details: 256 MiB copy killed with SIGKILL after first new destination pack; exit 137. Only prior point selectable and restorable. Retry published new byte-correct point with primary unavailable; repeat preserved destination IDs. No manual unlock needed for copy retry.

scenarios.name: Stale-lock maintenance recovery
scenarios.details: Exclusive full data check returned 11 until killed process was reaped and PID confirmed absent, then stale locks removed. Full secondary data check returned 0; source stale lock also removed.

limitations: Synthetic local filesystem proof only; no network endpoint or Kubernetes qualification.
Retry idempotence does not bound retransmitted bytes.

cleanup.localResources: Removal of temporary repositories/processes is not attested in original record.
cleanup.providerResources: Not used; no provider budget or cost recorded.

provenance.retention: Original detailed record remains in Git ancestry; recording commit is not by itself a tested-source binding.
